core_problem_solved: To provide a simple, cross-platform Java library for using ANSI escape codes to format console output, such as adding colors and styles, in a way that works on both Unix-like terminals and the Windows console.
key_features: ANSI escape code generation for text styling (color, bold, etc.)
Automatic detection and handling of platform-specific terminal support
A simple API for wrapping standard output streams to enable ANSI processing
era_and_niche: A useful utility library for any Java command-line application (CLI) that needs to produce styled text output in a cross-platform manner.
reason_for_obsolescence: The library is **not obsolete** but is a very specialized utility. Its functionality is often included in larger, more comprehensive command-line frameworks. The modern command-line parsing library **picocli**, for example, has its own, more powerful ANSI styling capabilities built-in, making Jansi redundant for projects that already use picocli.
